title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1968-10-20
source: SBD -> Rm -> Dat -> CD -> Sonic Solutions -> CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1968 show, highlighted by a smoking Schoolgirl bass line, epic Dark Star and tight St. Stephen into a ferocious The Eleven → Caution.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a clean, crisp soundboard mix (despite some level quirks on Schoolgirl) that lets the band's fire shine through.  This performance is packed with standout moments – Phil’s booming bass on Schoolgirl, a soaring Dark Star, flawless St. Stephen and an unforgettable Eleven‑to‑Caution transition – all delivered at a high‑octane energy level.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews (majority 5‑star) praise both the musical performance and the soundboard quality; only minor technical complaints appear, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean board noted by many reviewers; some mention uneven levels (Phil too loud, vocals low) and occasional mix imbalance on Schoolgirl, but overall very listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, seamless flow especially the Eleven→Caution transition; set builds nicely from Schoolgirl through Dark Star to a climactic finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for cooking on St. Stephen, dueling Phil in The Eleven and taking off during the jam sections.
band_member_comments.Phil: Repeatedly highlighted – “blows speakers”, booming bass line on Schoolgirl, extended solo, overall dominant presence throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (TC) noted high in the mix on Caution; Pigpen’s organ contributions also mentioned, adding texture to the jams.
